name: EX-11 Border Security Operation — 2 Days
description: 48-hour border security operation exercise covering enhanced border monitoring, interdiction of illicit cross-border movement, and coordination between border guard, customs, intelligence, and national police. Covers 24/7 shift operations with day/night cycles, checkpoints, surveillance assets, and incident response. Suitable for 2-day joint agency exercises.

groups.name: Border Guard Alpha
groups.description: Primary border guard unit — northern sector

layers.name: Border Guard Ops
layers.description: Border Guard Alpha and Bravo operations

items.title: INITEX — All Units
items.description: Exercise commences. All units report readiness to Joint Command. Sector assignments confirmed. Rules of Engagement (ROE) briefed. Communications check on all nets. Surveillance assets activated.

items.title: Sector Patrol — Alpha Northern
items.description: Border Guard Alpha begins motorised patrol of northern sector. Checkpoint Alpha-1 established at crossing point. Vehicle inspection procedures initiated. Liaison with local police established.

items.title: Intelligence Briefing — Threat Picture
items.description: Intelligence Cell briefs Command on current threat picture: two known smuggling networks active in area, UAV surveillance tasking approved for northern sector, tip from partner agency regarding planned crossing at grid reference foxtrot-7.

items.title: INJECT: Vehicle with Contraband Detected
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Customs team at crossing point detects anomalous cargo in transit vehicle. X-ray scanning reveals concealed compartment. Interdiction initiated. Border Guard Alpha provides security cordon. Intelligence Cell notified for documentation and debrief.

items.title: Shift Handover — Day to Night
items.description: Day shift hands over to night shift. Sector status briefing: all checkpoints status, active intelligence leads, outstanding tasks. Night shift commander assumes operational control. Shift handover documented in operations log.

items.title: Night Surveillance — UAV Tasking
items.description: UAV patrol tasked over northern sector based on intelligence tip. Thermal imaging active. Quick Reaction Force on 15-minute standby. Command notified of any contacts.

items.title: INJECT: Illegal Border Crossing — Group Contact
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: UAV detects group of 6 individuals attempting crossing at foxtrot-7. QRF deployed. Border Guard Bravo intercepts. Command coordinates response across Alpha and Bravo sectors. Procedures for processing, documentation, and welfare followed.

items.title: Day 2 Morning SITREP
items.description: Command issues SITREP to higher headquarters. 24-hour summary: 3 vehicle interdictions (2 minor, 1 major), 1 illegal crossing incident, all sectors green, no safety incidents. Intelligence updates incorporated into afternoon operations order.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise end declared by Chief Controller. All units stand down to safe state. Equipment and weapons cleared. Personnel accountability complete. All sections submit exercise logs to command.

items.title: After Action Review
items.description: Full exercise AAR. Topics: patrol effectiveness, checkpoint procedures, intelligence-operations integration, shift handover quality, incident response times, inter-agency communication. Lessons identified and owner-assigned for follow-up.
